```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggsci)
library(brms)
library(bayesplot)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(tidybayes)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r}
skeleton_data <- read.csv("Data/SkeletonData.csv") %>% dplyr::select(Abs_lat, Genus, Species, SitePair, UrchinID, Condition, TestDiameter, ThicknessCT.um., Porosity, MgCO3, Spine_length, Spine_diameter, Spine_porosity, Jaw_length) %>%
    rename(
         Site = Condition) 



environmental_data <- read.csv("Data/EnvData.csv")

# ---- Merge EnvData and Skeletal Data ---- #
dat_all <- skeleton_data %>%
  left_join(
    environmental_data,
    by = c("SitePair", "Site"))

dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    Biomineral       = 100 - Porosity,                  
    Biomineral_z     = as.numeric(scale(Biomineral)),
    Thickness_z      = as.numeric(scale(ThicknessCT.um.)),
    SpineDia_z       = as.numeric(scale(Spine_diameter)),
    SpineLen_z       = as.numeric(scale(Spine_length)),
    SpinePor_z       = as.numeric(scale(Spine_porosity)),
    SpineBiomineral  = 100 - Spine_porosity,
    SpineBiomineral_z     = as.numeric(scale(SpineBiomineral)),
    JawLen_z         = as.numeric(scale(Jaw_length)),
    TestDiameter_z = as.numeric(scale(TestDiameter)),
    pH_z = as.numeric(scale(median_pH)),
    SitePair = factor(SitePair),
    Analogue = factor(Analogue),
    Genus    = factor(Genus)
  )

dat_all$SiteID <- interaction(dat_all$Analogue,
                              dat_all$SitePair,
                              dat_all$Site,
                              drop = TRUE)
```

# pH models
```{r}
# ---- Full code for each, later using functions loop over traits ---- #

# Test Biomineral
model_biom_consistency <- brm(
  Biomineral_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Test Thickness
model_thi_consistency <- brm(
  Thickness_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Jaw Length
model_jaw_len_consistency <- brm(
  JawLen_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Spine Biomineral
model_spine_por_consistency <- brm(
  SpineBiomineral_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Spine Thickness
model_spine_dia_consistency <- brm(
  SpineDia_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Spine Length
model_spine_len_consistency <- brm(
  SpineLen_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# ---- Extract posterior draws for median pH ---- #
get_pH_draws <- function(model, response_name) {
  as_draws_df(model) %>%
    select(b_scalemedian_pH) %>%   # correct column name from brms
    mutate(response = response_name)
}

draws_all <- bind_rows(
  get_pH_draws(model_biom_consistency,        "Test Biomineral (%)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_thi_consistency,        "Test Thickness (µm)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_spine_por_consistency,  "Spine Biomineral (%)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_spine_dia_consistency,  "Spine Thickness (µm)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_spine_len_consistency,  "Spine Length (mm)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_jaw_len_consistency,    "Jaw Length (mm)")
)

# ---- Summarise posterior (median + 95% & 50% HDI) ---- #
sum_95 <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_scalemedian_pH, .width = 0.95) %>%
  rename(
    median      = b_scalemedian_pH,
    hdi_95_low  = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )

sum_50 <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_scalemedian_pH, .width = 0.50) %>%
  rename(
    hdi_50_low  = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )

effects_sum <- sum_95 %>%
  left_join(sum_50, by = "response")

effects_sum <- effects_sum %>%
  mutate(
    median_flip   = -median,
    hdi_95_low_flip = -hdi_95_high,  
    hdi_95_high_flip = -hdi_95_low,
    hdi_50_low_flip  = -hdi_50_high,
    hdi_50_high_flip = -hdi_50_low
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_color = case_when(
      median_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",  
      median_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE            ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),
    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low_flip  > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE                 ~ "#FFFFFF"
    ),
    response = factor(response, levels = c(
      "Jaw Length (mm)",
      "Spine Length (mm)",
      "Spine Thickness (µm)",
      "Spine Biomineral (%)",
      "Test Thickness (µm)",
      "Test Biomineral (%)"
    ))
  )

# ---- Plot (flip x-axis to show decreasing pH) ---- #
SiteEffects_pH <- ggplot(effects_sum, aes(x = median_flip, y = response)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = hdi_95_low_flip, xend = hdi_95_high_flip, yend = response, color = seg_color),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = hdi_50_low_flip, xend = hdi_50_high_flip, yend = response, color = seg_color),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_color),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(
    x = expression("β (Median pH"[T]*")"),
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


SiteEffects_pH

ggsave(
  "pH_MainEffect_plot.svg",
  plot = SiteEffects_pH,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```

# R2 Statistics
```{r}
models <- list(
  "Test Biomineral Content" = model_biom_consistency,
  "Test Thickness" = model_thi_consistency,
  "Jaw Length" = model_jaw_len_consistency,
  "Spine Biomineral Content" = model_spine_por_consistency,
  "Spine Thickness" = model_spine_dia_consistency,
  "Spine Length" = model_spine_len_consistency
)

r2_results <- lapply(names(models), function(trait){
  
  r2 <- bayes_R2(models[[trait]])
  
  data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    Estimate = r2[, "Estimate"],
    Est_Error = r2[, "Est.Error"],
    Q2.5 = r2[, "Q2.5"],
    Q97.5 = r2[, "Q97.5"]
  )
})

r2_results_pH_reduced_model <- dplyr::bind_rows(r2_results)

r2_results_pH_reduced_model

write.csv(r2_results_pH_reduced_model, "r2_results_pH_reduced_model.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Diagnostic plots for pH models
```{r}
color_scheme_set("purple")

save_model_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name, folder){

  
  dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  
  brms_plots <- plot(model)

  posterior_hist  <- brms_plots[[1]]
  posterior_trace <- brms_plots[[2]]

  
  pp <- pp_check(model) +
    ggtitle("Posterior predictive check")

  
  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    posterior_hist,
    posterior_trace,
    pp,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)
  )

  # Save to chosen folder
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(folder, "/", model_name, "_ALL_diagnostics.png"),
    plot = combined,
    width = 10,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

models <- list(
  "Test_Biomineral_Content" = model_biom_consistency,
  "Test_Thickness" = model_thi_consistency,
  "Jaw_Length" = model_jaw_len_consistency,
  "Spine_Biomineral_Content" = model_spine_por_consistency,
  "Spine_Thickness" = model_spine_dia_consistency,
  "Spine_Length" = model_spine_len_consistency
)

invisible(
  lapply(names(models), function(name){
    save_model_diagnostics(models[[name]], name,
                           "DiagnosticPlots/pH_models")
  })
)
```

# pH x Absolute Latitude interaction models
```{r}
traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)

dat_all$Abs_lat_z <- as.numeric(scale(dat_all$Abs_lat))

lat_mean <- mean(dat_all$Abs_lat)
lat_sd   <- sd(dat_all$Abs_lat)

pH_mean  <- mean(dat_all$median_pH)
pH_sd    <- sd(dat_all$median_pH)

lat_vals <- c(10, 25, 40)
lat_vals_z <- (lat_vals - lat_mean) / lat_sd

pH_lat_models <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(trait, " ~ 1 +
           pH_z * Abs_lat_z +
           TestDiameter_z +
           (1 + pH_z || Genus) +
           (1 | Analogue/SitePair)")
  )

  pH_lat_models[[trait]] <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = dat_all,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = 3,
    seed = 1999,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
  )
}

size_corrected_data <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  mod <- pH_lat_models[[trait]]
  beta_size <- fixef(mod)["TestDiameter_z","Estimate"]

  tmp <- dat_all %>%
    mutate(
      trait_value = .data[[trait]],
      trait_corr  = trait_value - beta_size * TestDiameter_z
    )

  size_corrected_data[[trait]] <- tmp
}

trait_to_label <- c(
  Biomineral = "Predicted Test Biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Predicted Test Thickness (µm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Predicted Spine Biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Predicted Spine Thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Predicted Spine Length (mm)",
  Jaw_length = "Predicted Jaw Length (mm)"
)

fitted_plots <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  mod <- pH_lat_models[[trait]]

  newdata <- expand.grid(
    pH_z = seq(min(dat_all$pH_z),
               max(dat_all$pH_z),
               length.out = 100),
    Abs_lat_z = lat_vals_z,
    TestDiameter_z = 0
  )

  fitted <- add_epred_draws(mod,
                            newdata = newdata,
                            re_formula = NA)

  fitted <- fitted %>%
    mutate(
      median_pH = pH_z * pH_sd + pH_mean,
      Abs_lat   = Abs_lat_z * lat_sd + lat_mean,
      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35  ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35   ~ 40
      ),
      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40,25,10),
        labels = c("40°","25°","10°")
      )
    )

  fitted_summary <- fitted %>%
    group_by(median_pH, lat_label) %>%
    median_hdci(.epred, .width = c(0.95, 0.5)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(lat_label, median_pH)

  hd95 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, lat_label,
           hdi_95_low = .lower,
           hdi_95_high = .upper)

  hd50 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.5) %>% 
    select(median_pH, lat_label,
           hdi_50_low = .lower,
           hdi_50_high = .upper)

  median_vals <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, lat_label,
           median = .epred)

  plot_data <- median_vals %>%
    left_join(hd95, by = c("median_pH","lat_label")) %>%
    left_join(hd50, by = c("median_pH","lat_label"))

  overlay_data <- size_corrected_data[[trait]] %>%
    mutate(
      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35  ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35   ~ 40
      ),
      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40,25,10),
        labels = c("40°","25°","10°")
      )
    )

  y_label <- trait_to_label[[trait]]

  p <- ggplot(plot_data,
              aes(x = median_pH, y = median)) +

    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_95_low,
                    ymax = hdi_95_high,
                    fill = lat_label,
                    group = lat_label),
                alpha = 0.2) +

    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_50_low,
                    ymax = hdi_50_high,
                    fill = lat_label,
                    group = lat_label),
                alpha = 0.4) +

   geom_line(aes(group = lat_label),
          color = "black",
          size = 1) +

    geom_point(data = overlay_data,
               aes(x = median_pH,
                   y = trait_corr,
                   color = lat_label),
               alpha = 0.6,
               size = 2,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +

    facet_wrap(~ lat_label) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "40°" = "lightblue",
      "25°" = "orange",
      "10°" = "red"
    )) +

    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "40°" = "lightblue",
      "25°" = "orange",
      "10°" = "red"
    )) +

    scale_x_reverse(
      limits = c(8.22, 7.54),
      breaks = seq(7.6, 8.2, by = 0.2),
      expand = c(0.02,0.02)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                  fill = NA,
                                  size = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(x = expression("pH"[T]), y = y_label)

  fitted_plots[[trait]] <- p
  print(p)
}

combined_pH_lat_line_plot <- wrap_plots(fitted_plots, ncol = 3)
combined_pH_lat_line_plot

ggsave(
  "Combined_pH_lat_lineplots.svg",
  combined_pH_lat_line_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 8
)
```

# Genus-specific responses
```{r}
traits <- c("Biomineral",
            "ThicknessCT.um.",
            "Jaw_length",
            "SpineBiomineral", 
            "Spine_diameter", 
            "Spine_length")

trait_labels <- c(
  Biomineral = "Test Biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Test Thickness (µm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Spine Biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Spine Thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Spine Length (mm)",
  Jaw_length = "Jaw Length (mm)"
)

# ----- Genus-specific prediction curves (at mean latitude) ----- #
pH_seq <- seq(min(dat_all$pH_z),
              max(dat_all$pH_z),
              length.out = 100)

newdata <- expand.grid(
  pH_z = pH_seq,
  Abs_lat_z = 0,
  TestDiameter_z = 0,
  Genus = unique(dat_all$Genus),
  Analogue = unique(dat_all$Analogue)[1],
  SitePair = unique(dat_all$SitePair)[1]
)

fitted_list <- list()

for(trait in traits){
  
  mod <- pH_lat_models[[trait]]
  
  fitted <- add_epred_draws(
  object = mod,
  newdata = newdata,
  re_formula = ~(1 + pH_z | Genus),   
  allow_new_levels = TRUE,
  ndraws = 1000
) %>%
    mutate(Trait = trait)
  
  fitted_list[[trait]] <- fitted
}

fitted_all <- bind_rows(fitted_list) %>%
  mutate(
    median_pH_raw = pH_z * pH_sd + pH_mean,
    Trait_label = factor(trait_labels[Trait],
                         levels = trait_labels[traits])
  )

fitted_summary <- fitted_all %>%
  group_by(Trait, Genus, pH_z, median_pH_raw, Trait_label) %>%
  median_hdci(.epred, .width = c(0.95, 0.50)) %>%
  ungroup()

fitted_summary_wide <- fitted_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = .width,
              values_from = c(.epred, .lower, .upper)) %>%
  rename(
    median = .epred_0.95,
    hdi_95_low = .lower_0.95,
    hdi_95_high = .upper_0.95,
    hdi_50_low = .lower_0.5,
    hdi_50_high = .upper_0.5
  )

genus_order <- c("Arbacia","Paracentrotus","Echinometra","Evechinus","Diadema")

genus_colors <- c(
  Arbacia = "#d96b6b",
  Paracentrotus = "#f4a261",
  Echinometra = "#7f9cc9",
  Evechinus = "#6fcf97",
  Diadema = "#7a5aa6"
)

fitted_summary_wide$Genus <- factor(fitted_summary_wide$Genus,
                                    levels = genus_order)

Genus_line_plots <- ggplot(
  fitted_summary_wide,
  aes(x = median_pH_raw,
      y = median,
      group = Genus,
      color = Genus,
      fill = Genus)
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_95_low,
                  ymax = hdi_95_high),
              alpha = 0.2,
              color = NA) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_50_low,
                  ymax = hdi_50_high),
              alpha = 0.4,
              color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Trait_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = genus_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colors) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(x = expression(pH[T]),
       y = "Predicted Trait Value") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black")
  )

ggsave("Genus_line_plots.svg",
       Genus_line_plots,
       width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```


# pH x SST interaction models
```{r}
traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)

temp_vals <- c(18, 23, 28)

dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    pH_z = as.numeric(scale(median_pH)),
    Temp_z = as.numeric(scale(median_temp)),
    TestDiameter_z = as.numeric(scale(TestDiameter))
  )

pH_temp_models <- list()

for(trait in traits){

 formula <- as.formula(
  paste0(trait, " ~ 1 +
         pH_z * Temp_z +
         TestDiameter_z +
         (1 + pH_z || Genus) +
         (1 | Analogue/SitePair)")
)

  pH_temp_models[[trait]] <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = dat_all,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = 3,
    seed = 123,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
  )
}

temp_vals_z <- (temp_vals - mean(dat_all$median_temp)) / sd(dat_all$median_temp)
testdiam_mean_z <- mean(dat_all$TestDiameter_z)

size_corrected_data <- list()

for(trait in traits){
  
  mod <- pH_temp_models[[trait]]
  

  beta_size <- fixef(mod)["TestDiameter_z","Estimate"]
  
  tmp <- dat_all %>%
    mutate(
      trait_value = .data[[trait]],
      trait_corr = trait_value - beta_size * TestDiameter_z
    )
  
  size_corrected_data[[trait]] <- tmp
}

# ---- Plot ---- #

fitted_plots <- list()

for(trait in traits){
  
  mod <- pH_temp_models[[trait]]
  
  newdata <- expand.grid(
    pH_z = seq(min(dat_all$pH_z), max(dat_all$pH_z), length.out = 50),
    Temp_z = temp_vals_z,
    TestDiameter_z = testdiam_mean_z
  )
  
 
  fitted <- add_epred_draws(mod, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA)
  
  
  fitted <- fitted %>%
    mutate(
      median_pH = pH_z * sd(dat_all$median_pH) + mean(dat_all$median_pH),
      median_temp = Temp_z * sd(dat_all$median_temp) + mean(dat_all$median_temp)
    )
  

  fitted_summary <- fitted %>%
    group_by(median_pH, median_temp) %>%
    median_hdci(.epred, .width = c(0.95, 0.5)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  hd95 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, median_temp,
           hdi_95_low = .lower,
           hdi_95_high = .upper)
  
  hd50 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.5) %>% 
    select(median_pH, median_temp,
           hdi_50_low = .lower,
           hdi_50_high = .upper)
  
  median_vals <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, median_temp,
           median = .epred)
  
  plot_data <- median_vals %>%
    left_join(hd95, by = c("median_pH","median_temp")) %>%
    left_join(hd50, by = c("median_pH","median_temp")) %>%
    mutate(
      median_temp_label = factor(
        median_temp,
        levels = temp_vals,
        labels = paste0(temp_vals,"°C")
      )
    )
  

 overlay_data <- size_corrected_data[[trait]] %>%
  mutate(
    median_temp_label = factor(
      temp_vals[
        apply(abs(outer(median_temp, temp_vals, "-")), 1, which.min)
      ],
      levels = temp_vals,
      labels = paste0(temp_vals, "°C")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(median_temp_label %in% unique(plot_data$median_temp_label))
  
  
  y_label <- trait_to_label[[trait]]
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = median_pH, y = median)) +
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_95_low,
                    ymax = hdi_95_high,
                    fill = median_temp_label),
                alpha = 0.2) +
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_50_low,
                    ymax = hdi_50_high,
                    fill = median_temp_label),
                alpha = 0.4) +
    
    geom_line(aes(group = median_temp_label),
              color = "black",
              size = 1) +
    
    geom_point(
  data = overlay_data,
  aes(x = median_pH,
      y = trait_corr,
      color = median_temp_label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.6,
  size = 2
) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ median_temp_label) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("18°C" = "lightblue",
                                 "23°C" = "orange",
                                 "28°C" = "red")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "18°C" = "lightblue",
  "23°C" = "orange",
  "28°C" = "red"
)) +
    
    labs(
      x = expression("pH"[T]),
      y = y_label
    ) +
    
scale_x_reverse(
  limits = c(8.22, 7.54),
  breaks = seq(7.6, 8.2, by = 0.2),
  expand = c(0.02,0.02)
) +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                  fill = NA,
                                  size = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  fitted_plots[[trait]] <- p
  print(p)
}

combined_pH_temp_line_plot <- wrap_plots(fitted_plots, ncol = 3)
combined_pH_temp_line_plot

ggsave(
  "Combined_pH_temp_lineplots.svg",
  combined_pH_temp_line_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 8
)

```
